articles.title: Native date picker
articles.desc: We replaced the date picker with the default html date picker to improve the user experience, the accessibility and performance.

articles.title: Tracking preferences checkbox
articles.desc: We added on the profile edition (front-end), a checkbox available for all users to manage their tracking preferences.

articles.title: Lighter installation package
articles.desc: Development files are no longer included in the third-party libraries shipped with the package, resulting in a lighter and cleaner installation.

articles.title: Website default language
articles.desc: Newsletters now use the website default language instead of the administrator language for dynamic tags like {date:X}, the 'Read more' text and the default templates.

splash_content.title: THE FIXES INCLUDED IN THIS VERSION

articles.title: Custom fields security
articles.desc: Security for some custom fields has been enhanced.

articles.title: Mailbox actions security
articles.desc: A security issue related to a very specific scenario has been fixed in the mailbox actions.

articles.title: File upload error message
articles.desc: We fixed the error message displayed when uploading a file of a non-accepted type that showed raw HTML instead of a readable message.

articles.title: Links in form texts
articles.desc: We have fixed the display of links added in subscription form texts and custom fields that were removed on display.

articles.title: List-Unsubscribe header
articles.desc: We fixed the List-Unsubscribe header so one-click unsubscribe works again.

articles.title: HTML characters in translations
articles.desc: Some translations were not properly replacing HTML characters.

articles.title: Lower case imported emails
articles.desc: Imported email addresses are now always stored in lower case, preventing case sensitive duplicates and subscriptions or custom fields being silently skipped during an import.

articles.title: Empty date columns on import
articles.desc: Importing users with an empty date column (like the last open or last click date) no longer triggers a database error, the value is now stored as empty.

articles.title: Campaign creation access error
articles.desc: An 'Access denied for this email' error has been fixed when creating a campaign from the dashboard while the favorite template had been deleted.

articles.title: Listing action buttons
articles.desc: The action buttons now work again on the follow-up, automation and mailbox action listings, where the duplicate buttons silently reloaded the page without doing the action asked and the statistics button did nothing when clicked.

articles.title: Joomla contacts import
articles.desc: We fixed the importing of Joomla contacts that could fail due to a case sensitive issue.

articles.title: DP Calendar menu item
articles.desc: [add-ons] We added an option to specify the menu item to use for DP Calendar event links.

articles.title: Multilingual form 404
articles.desc: The subscription form no longer returns a 404 error when submitted from a secondary language on multilingual websites using Polylang or WPML.
